status.en: 6 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 46% fewer than the week before, most of them in Damascus, Quneitra and Aleppo.
status.nb: 6 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 46 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Aleppo.

summary.en: Bomb attacks continued in Damascus suburbs, with a car bomb killing a child and another person in Jaramana and an explosion killing a father and his child near the capital, while separate car bomb blasts killed two people, including a child, in the capital area. Israeli troops remain active in Syria, creating tension and the risk of new enemies, and the window for an Israeli-Syrian peace deal is closing. Jordan sentenced three people to death for a Greek Orthodox church attack. The UN noted that progress in Syria is real but fragile, and OCHA warned Syrians cannot afford more instability. The conflict caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Bombeangrep fortsatte i forstedene rundt Damaskus, med en bilbombe som drepte et barn og en annen person i Jaramana og en eksplosjon som drepte en far og hans barn nær hovedstaden, mens separate bilbombeangrep drepte to personer, inkludert et barn, i hovedstadsområdet. Israelske tropper forblir aktive i Syria, noe som skaper spenning og risiko for nye fiender, og vinduet for en israelsk-syrisk fredsavtale lukkes. Jordan dømte tre personer til døden for et angrep på en gresk-ortodoks kirke. FN bemerket at fremgangen i Syria er reell men skjør, og OCHA advarte at syrere ikke har råd til mer ustabilitet. Konflikten forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall knyttet til kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
